svg.title: W for Website and Landing Page
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold W gains a browser bar and a miniature website with navigation, hero art, a call-to-action and cursor. It moves left as the website and landing-page heading and examples of websites, landing pages and responsive layouts appear.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop. W, browser bar, cursor and teal, ink, cream and coral palette adapted from 23_W_web_design.png. All graphics, animation and typography are embedded. Websites shown are illustrative concepts.

g.text: FROM FIRST CLICK TO NEXT STEP
